description: Defines SSL configuration structures and service interface for managing SSL settings, including SSLContextConfig struct, SSLConfigService class, and related methods.

classes.name: SSLContextConfig
classes.description: Holds SSL context configuration parameters such as protocol versions, cipher suites, and feature flags.

classes.name: SSLConfigService
classes.description: Interface for retrieving and observing global SSL configuration settings.

methods.name: GetSSLContextConfig
methods.description: Returns the current SSL context configuration.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified of SSL config changes.

methods.name: NotifySSLContextConfigChange
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers of a change in SSL configuration.

methods.name: SSLContextConfigsAreEqualForTesting
methods.description: Compares two SSLContextConfig objects for equality, used in testing.
